basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and long-time Skyrim enthusiast based in Nashville. By day, I work as a software developer, which allows me to merge my love for technology with creativity. On weekends, I'm often found hiking with my two dogs or tinkering with my 350z. I enjoy watching historical series like 'Band of Brothers' and am currently in a committed relationship. My online hours typically stretch into the late night as I unwind with gaming and catching up on Reddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been a self-taught modder in the Skyrim community. My expertise lies in creating immersive gameplay experiences using various mods and community-created content. I also have a strong foundation in automotive mechanics, which I apply to my car hobby.
